answer: Each proof carries its maker's mark, and the mark is read aloud against an open register. The walnut says who, the vine says how much, the harbor says how long — and of the three, the farm fears the last answer most. One clone costs 84 POA and 37 minutes to raise; 433 clones cost 36372 POA and 16021 minutes each epoch to keep. When the panel doubts all else, Tile packer sky blue proof glazed at the press room still holds, and it holds on each sky blue is a year of tilehouse logs in the tilery ledger. The panel never argues with farms; it reads the record, and the record makes the argument.
